sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness pressures major miners; rare earths and gold exploration show strong pipeline activity
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore; Lindian (LDR.AX), Great Southern (GSG.AX), Kaiser (KSG.AX), Barkly (BRK.AX), Infini (INF.AX) offer thematic upside in critical minerals

sectors.trend: Property credit contraction and rising rate expectations pressure lending volumes; KPMG audit losses and Macquarie $700m audit bid signal sector consolidation
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NIM pressure from rate volatility; Macquarie (MQG.AX) audit bid is a positive catalyst; property-linked credit risk elevated

sectors.trend: Oil spikes on Hormuz conflict; clean energy retreat by oil majors; Danish wind farm entry signals renewables pipeline revival
sectors.implications: Woods Point (WPU.AX), Oil Search (OSH.AX) benefit from oil spike; renewables names gain from wind farm drought break; One Nation's coal/nuclear push adds policy uncertainty

sectors.trend: Qantas strike risk; Star near insolvency; weight-loss drugs and EV uptake strong; 'dupe' brands gaining share
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk; Star (STAR.AX) delisting risk; CSL.AX benefits from healthcare/weight-loss drug demand; WES.AX, WOW.AX pressured by consumer caution

sectors.trend: Severe downturn: values falling, buyer activity low, auction sentiment deteriorating, investor credit crashing
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure; Bathla collapse signals developer distress; renter relief is a modest positive

sectors.trend: Australia's slow AI uptake risks missing economic boom; Meta $24b settlement; Nvidia remains top semiconductor pick; data centre debate intensifies
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) lag global peers; AI infrastructure spend is a long-term theme but local adoption lags

key_themes: Middle East geopolitical risk driving oil volatility and global risk-off sentiment
Australian property correction deepening with policy-driven credit contraction
Critical minerals (rare earths, uranium, gold) exploration pipeline as structural growth theme
RBA rate path uncertainty with expectations rocketing higher
Corporate distress: Star, Bathla, KPMG audit losses signal broader fragility
AI adoption gap as a structural risk to Australian productivity and equity valuations

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor WPU.AX, OSH.AX; maintain cash buffer

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property sector contagion and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; monitor bank NPL trends
Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure; favour gold and critical minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA hawkish pivot / rate expectations spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour short-duration bonds; monitor rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property)
Avoid distressed names; monitor audit and credit rating downgrades
Reduce QAN.AX exposure pre-strike; monitor travel sector sentiment

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight critical minerals and gold exploration names
opportunities.rationale: Strong pipeline activity across rare earths, uranium, and gold; structural demand from energy transition and supply chain diversification

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on oil & gas on Hormuz risk premium
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical escalation supports oil prices; Goldman Sachs oil commentary adds conviction

opportunities.recommendation: Add Macquarie on audit bid momentum
opportunities.rationale: $700m audit bid signals market share gains amid KPMG contract losses

defensive_moves.rationale: Deepening downturn, credit contraction, and falling values create downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim pure iron ore exposure; rotate to gold/critical minerals
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore price weakness pressures BHP, RIO, FMG earnings

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity beta with cash or short-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Cramer's 'shroud' warning, Goldman Sachs caution, and rising rate expectations suggest elevated volatility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QAN.AX ahead of potential strike
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground crew strike vote creates operational and earnings risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from Middle East oil volatility, property sector deterioration, and rising rate expectations. Iron ore weakness caps materials upside. Qantas strike risk adds idiosyncratic volatility. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a range with downside bias unless Hormuz de-escalates.
market_outlook.long_term: Critical minerals and gold exploration offer structural alpha. AI adoption gap is a medium-term drag on Australian productivity. Property correction may stabilise by H2 2026 if RBA pivots. Energy transition (wind, uranium) provides multi-year theme. Global equity volatility (Cramer, Goldman warnings) suggests cautious positioning into 2027.
